name: mlx-swift
description: The foundational Node.js bridge to Apple's MLX framework via Swift. Native Apple Silicon acceleration with zero-dependency Node-API bindings.

scripts.node:napi-version: grep -rih "#define napi_version \d" "$(npm run -s node:include)" | awk '{print "{\"" tolower($2) "\": " $3 "}"}'
scripts.build:swift:product: find $(swift build --configuration release --show-bin-path) -name "lib$(swift package dump-package | jq -r '.products[0].name').a"
scripts.build:napi: clang -O3 -shared -DVERSION="\"$npm_package_version\"" -I"$(npm run -s node:include)" binding.c "$(npm run -s build:swift:product)" -o mlx.node -undefined dynamic_lookup -L/usr/lib/swift -mmacosx-version-min=14.0
scripts.build: npm run build:swift && npm run build:metal && npm run build:napi && cp $(npm run -s build:metal:product) default.metallib

author: Ivo von Putzer Reibegg <ivo.putzer@gmail.com> (https://github.com/ivoputzer)
